# cpanel_mysql_restrictions (Data Source)

Reads the cPanel MySQL or MariaDB account naming restrictions through `Mysql::get_restrictions`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cpanel_mysql_restrictions" "account" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `max_database_name_length` (Number) The maximum complete database-name length reported by cPanel.
- `max_username_length` (Number) The maximum complete database username length reported by cPanel.
- `prefix` (String) The prefix cPanel applies to database and database user names, or an empty string when prefixing is disabled.
